@tufail Had the same problem here. I rolled back just to v13.1.1 and everything's fine. 

Must be a bug in the update a week ago.

I'm seeing the same thing, an import of global scss styles is causing the next app to fail to start. There is no error or other output seen, the app just silently fails to start.

Commenting/uncommenting the following line in my pages/_app.tsx file causes this to work/break.

`import '../styles/globals.scss';`

This does not happen with 13.1.1, but does happen with 13.1.2.

Same issue.  This is a breaking change for me.  I rolled back to 12.3.  to get sass to work again.  I will try 13.1.1

*. I can confirm it works in 13.1.1. but not work with 13.1.2 or "latest"
+1; I wasted a lot of time on this one being new to Next.js, but reverting from 13.1.4 to 13.1.1 worked.
+1 I have the same issue and reverting to 13.1.1 works for me as well.
Can also confirm. 13.1.4 broken. 13.1.1 works. Glad it wasn't just me.

I believe you are putting the --turbo flag in the package.json in the dev script

I didn't have this problem, Next.js v13.1.4
I don't have the turbo flag in my case.
